title: Marlowe raises a $277m seed to build inference factories around non-Nvidia chips
summary: Marlowe, founded in May by former Convoy chief executive Dan Lewis and ex-Microsoft AI infrastructure leader Kutta Srinivasan, raised $277 million in a seed round led by Accel at a $1.15 billion valuation. The company designs, builds and runs data centres for inference, starting with AMD and Etched chips rather than Nvidia GPUs, and says tuning each layer for a given workload can cut cost. Its first site, built on Etched silicon, is due in December for an unnamed large AI coding customer; a larger AMD Helios site is planned for the second quarter of 2027.
